channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Parliament Urged to Drive Social Development and Citizen Engagement
item.description: Uzbekistan's parliament must become a driving force for social development, focusing beyond economic growth to include decent work, education, and social protection. A UN resolution, initiated by Uzbekistan and adopted by 167 countries, emphasizes the role of parliaments in social progress and human-centered development.

item.title: Uzbek President Addresses Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev expressed gratitude for Kyrgyzstan's warm welcome and excellent organization of the SCO summit. He congratulated the Kyrgyz people on their 35th anniversary of state sovereignty, noting Kyrgyzstan's development and growing international authority. Mirziyoyev also acknowledged Kazakhstan's Qasym-Jomart Tokayev on the opening of the Kurultai's first session.

item.title: Uzbek President Reviews 25 Years of Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev participated in the jubilee 25th anniversary meeting of the SCO Heads of State Council in Bishkek. Discussions covered the organization's achievements, future tasks for strengthening stability, expanding cooperation, and joint development. Leaders exchanged views on pressing international and regional issues. Mirziyoyev and the Uzbek people were congratulated on Independence Day.

item.title: UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions to be Established in Almaty
item.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev stated that global stability increasingly depends on responsible AI development. He announced that Kazakhstan will establish the UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions in Almaty. The center aims to scale up best practices, particularly for developing countries, ensuring technological progress benefits all humanity.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt Aim to Expand Economic and Political Cooperation
item.description: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt are set to expand economic, trade, and cultural cooperation. Discussions included Egypt's role as an SCO dialogue partner. Kyrgyzstan's embassy opening in Cairo and a 2025 presidential visit aim to strengthen ties between Central Asia and the Arab world.

item.title: Kazakh President proposes enshrining SCO principles in UN General Assembly resolution
item.description: Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev suggested formalizing key SCO principles in a UN General Assembly resolution for the International Day of Multilateralism and Diplomacy. Speaking at the SCO Plus summit in Bishkek, he emphasized the need for a new world order based on mutual responsibility and cooperation, citing the SCO's Shanghai spirit as a model.

item.title: Tajik President: UN and SCO can help shape a just world order
item.description: Tajikistan's President Emomali Rahmon stated at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek that the UN and SCO can play a greater role in forming a just, inclusive, and sustainable world order. He emphasized that both organizations can enhance their roles by relying on shared values and constructive interaction principles. Tajikistan is ready to contribute to this process.

item.title: Kazakhstan willing to host SCO Development Bank headquarters
item.description: Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev proposed launching SCO cross-border trade zones and supported China's initiative to create an SCO Development Bank. He stated that Kazakhstan could host the bank's headquarters if member states reach a consensus. Tokayev also emphasized Kazakhstan's commitment to integrating major projects like the Belt and Road Initiative and the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route.

item.title: Armenian PM Pashinyan meets US delegation in Bishkek to discuss strategic partnership
item.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan met with a US delegation led by Senator Steve Daines in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. They emphasized the importance of developing strategic partnership between Armenia and the US across various sectors. Discussions also covered regional processes and the TRIPP project for communication development.

item.title: OPEC Fund provides $30 million loan for reconstruction of Rushan-Varsez road in Tajikistan
item.description: The OPEC Fund has allocated a $30 million loan for the first phase of the Rushan-Varsez road reconstruction project in Tajikistan. The project aims to strengthen a key transport corridor and improve connectivity with China. A partnership framework agreement for 2026-2028 was also signed.

item.title: EU and UK Ambassadors draw parallels between Uzbekistan's regional integration and Europe's past
item.description: EU Ambassador Toivo Klaar compares current Central Asian political processes to Europe's post-WWII integration, highlighting Uzbekistan's central role. UK Ambassador Timothy Smart notes shared belief in education and innovation, linking Uzbekistan's history to the Silk Road's intellectual exchange.

item.title: Kazakh President Addresses 'Three Evils' at SCO Summit
item.description: Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev highlighted key priorities for the SCO, emphasizing the fight against terrorism, extremism, and separatism. He noted the growing risk of transborder crises due to armed conflicts affecting global markets and supply chains. Tokayev also supported initiatives for centers combating security threats and drug trafficking.

item.title: Putin: UN Potential Far From Fully Realized
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated at the SCO Plus summit in Bishkek that the UN's potential is not yet fully realized. He emphasized the UN's role as a unique platform for dialogue and cooperation, calling for increased representation from the Global South and East, particularly in the Security Council, and adaptation to global changes.

item.title: Iran Offers to Participate in Kyrgyzstan Oil Refinery Construction
item.description: Iran is prepared to invest in building an oil refinery in Kyrgyzstan, according to Tasnim media. The proposal includes supplying crude oil and distributing petroleum products between the two nations. Iran also suggested establishing a logistics center in Iran's Bandar Abbas port for Kyrgyzstan.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of 28 Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, chaired by Kyrgyzstan's President Sadyr Japarov, concluded on September 1st with the signing of 28 documents. Discussions focused on security, anti-drug cooperation, digitalization, ecology, and logistics. The Bishkek Declaration and amendments to the SCO Charter were key political outcomes.

item.title: Uzbek President Outlines Key Proposals at SCO Summit in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed developing a "SCO-2040: Common Development Space" concept and an SCO Industrial Cooperation Map. He also suggested launching an SCO Development Bank and hosting a forum on AI in Tashkent next year.

item.title: Uzbek President Outlines Key SCO Priorities at Anniversary Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev defined the most pressing tasks for the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) at its anniversary meeting. The summit concluded with the adoption of the Bishkek Declaration and documents strengthening multilateral cooperation on nuclear and physical security, and priority areas of collaboration.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes SCO-2040 Concept and Industrial Cooperation Development
item.description: Speaking at the SCO summit in Bishkek, President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed the "SCO-2040" concept and developing industrial cooperation. He emphasized Central Asia's central role in the SCO and highlighted growing geopolitical divisions, lack of trust, and escalating conflicts globally. Mirziyoyev also expressed concern over the Middle East situation.

item.title: Tajikistan Academy of Sciences conducts research expedition on Surkhob glacier
item.description: Specialists from Tajikistan's Institute of Glaciology and Cryosphere, along with Austrian university ISTA, conducted a research expedition and monitoring of the Surkhob glacier. The expedition aimed to install meteorological and hydrological instruments, monitor the glacier's condition, and study climate change impacts. Samples were collected for chemical analysis.

item.title: Uzbekistan Ranks Among Top 5 Globally for Tourism Growth
item.description: Uzbekistan welcomed 7.75 million foreign tourists from January to July 2026, a 22.6% increase year-on-year. The country leads Central Asia in tourism development pace and ranks globally in the top five. Infrastructure development, including airport modernizations and new tourism complexes, is ongoing.

item.title: UN Warns of Severe Consequences from Rapid Sea Level Rise
item.description: The UN reports that global sea levels are rising faster than ever, posing significant risks to populations, economies, health, culture, and human rights. The report highlights that sea-level rise is causing flooding, loss of livelihoods, and increased threats to coastal communities worldwide, driven by climate change and melting glaciers.

item.title: Dushanbe Increases Public Transport Fleet by 360 Vehicles
item.description: Dushanbe has increased its public transport fleet by 360 vehicles, a 20% rise, starting September 1. This includes buses, trolleybuses, and minibuses. The move aims to accommodate the increased passenger numbers with the start of the academic year. The city plans to gradually add more electric vehicles.

item.title: Iran Views SCO Summit as Opportunity to Counter US Policy
item.description: Iran's participation in the SCO summit offers strategic opportunities to boost trade and economic ties amid US-induced instability in the Persian Gulf, according to an Iranian lawmaker. The SCO platform is seen as a chance to expand economic partnerships and counter Washington's policies.

item.title: Nearly 30 Documents Signed at Bishkek SCO Summit
item.description: Around 30 documents were signed at the regular meeting of the heads of state of SCO member countries in Bishkek on September 1st. The Bishkek Declaration, commemorating the SCO's 25th anniversary, and documents aimed at strengthening multilateral cooperation were adopted.

item.title: SCO is World's Largest Regional Organization, Says Putin
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) is effectively the world's largest regional organization. Member states represent nearly half the global population and over a third of global GDP, possessing significant intellectual, technological, and natural resources.

item.title: Omurbek Babanov announces withdrawal from presidential race, ending political career
item.description: Former Prime Minister Omurbek Babanov has declared he will not run for president and has concluded his political career. The announcement marks a significant shift in the country's political landscape.

item.title: Trump labels Iran a 'state in crisis,' claims leadership is incapable
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has officially declared Iran a 'state in crisis,' asserting that its leadership is incapable of governing and has lost its military strength. He alleged that the government is not paying its military and police forces.

item.title: Putin highlights SCO as largest regional association, emphasizing trade and potential
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the SCO is the largest regional association globally, encompassing nearly half the world's population and over a third of global GDP. He noted the bloc's significant intellectual, technological, and natural resource potential, emphasizing increased trade among member states as a key objective.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of Key Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek concluded with the adoption of several important documents, including amendments to the SCO Charter and regulations for a Universal Center. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced the establishment of a Center for Combating International Organized Crime in Bishkek.

item.title: Belarus President Advocates Unified Digital Space for SCO Members
item.description: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko called for the swift creation of a unified, open, and secure digital space within the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO). Speaking at the SCO Summit in Bishkek, he also supported establishing an SCO Development Bank to enhance economic ties and financial sovereignty, and increasing the use of national currencies in mutual settlements.

item.title: OIC Foreign Ministers Elect New Secretary-General, Discuss Palestine in Jeddah
item.description: Foreign ministers of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) met in Jeddah to elect Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed of Mauritania as the new Secretary-General and discuss the situation in Palestine. Tajikistan's Ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Akram Karimi, attended and spoke, highlighting Tajikistan's initiative for a decade of peace.

item.title: Tajik citizens in Russia can register residency via Amina app from September 1
item.description: Starting September 1, 2026, foreign citizens in Russia, including those from Tajikistan, must use the Amina mobile application for residency registration. Previously used in Moscow and the Moscow region, the app's scope has expanded to cover all foreign nationals entering Russia visa-free. The app allows individuals over 18 to register their place of residence.

item.title: Emomali Rahmon's speech at the 79th UN General Assembly session
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon addressed the 79th session of the UN General Assembly. His speech touched upon topics including the "cold war," artificial intelligence, "two-faced policy," and the situations in Palestine and Afghanistan.

item.title: Winning projects announced in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative
item.description: Over 2,195 projects have been selected as winners in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative, following the conclusion of the voting process. More than 10 million votes were cast nationwide. Details are available via the provided link.

item.title: Tajik Prime Minister Meets with OPEC Fund President to Discuss Cooperation
item.description: Tajikistan's Prime Minister Kohir Rasulzada met with the President of the OPEC Fund for International Development, Abdulhamid Alkhalifa, on August 31. They expressed satisfaction with bilateral relations and cooperation, anticipating further expansion. The signing of a Country Partnership Strategy for 2026-2028 was discussed.

item.title: Indian PM Modi Urges Putin to End Ukraine War and Seek Peaceful Resolution
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to end the war in Ukraine and resolve issues peacefully, according to excerpts from their August 31 conversation. Modi emphasized that continuing the war pushes humanity backward, while peace efforts offer hope.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Economy Grows 8.5% in First Half of 2026, Driven by Demand and Investment
item.description: Uzbekistan's economy expanded by 8.5% in the first half of 2026, accelerating from 7.7% in 2025. Growth is supported by consumer demand, investment, and services, with retail sales up 20.2% and capital investments increasing by 17.5%. Foreign direct investment reached $39.6 billion, with significant contributions from China and the Persian Gulf.

item.title: New Electric Train to Reduce Travel Time Between Tashkent and Andijan
item.description: A new Chinese-made CR200J electric train will soon operate between Tashkent and Andijan, with test runs currently underway. The train covers the distance in 4 hours, significantly reducing the current 6-7 hour journey. It can carry approximately 400 passengers and reach speeds of up to 160 km/h.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek: Leaders Discuss Regional Security, AI, and Future Projects
item.description: Bishkek hosts the 25th anniversary Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit with leaders from all 10 member states attending. Discussions focus on regional security, economic applications of AI, and future projects. The summit aims to adopt the Bishkek Declaration, building on the organization's evolution from a border security pact to a broader regional forum.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon Attends Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon participated in the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek on August 31. The games, held in Kyrgyzstan until September 6, coincide with Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day and the SCO summit. Rahmon held meetings with leaders of several SCO member states and other governments.
